rows.en:
(I'm meeting Gary-sensei
at Central Park today.)
Hey, you're late.
Oh, Sensei, you're early.
Yeah, well. It happens sometimes...
(Something about the mood feels different today...)

Say, \p...
You got any dreams...?

A dream... huh... Hmm...
What about you, Sensei?
Me, I'm thinking I wanna start a ranch someday...
A ranch...?
Yeah. Shearing sheep, milking cows, that kinda thing.

And, y'know, riding a horse across a wide meadow
chasing cattle, that'd be pretty fun too...
Is that so? So it's nothing to do with the sky.

Yeah. The sky holds nothing but painful
memories for me...
Huh?! What do you mean...
You got any brothers?
rows.notes: Male only ('kyoudai'); female version c05430 asks about sisters.

rows.en: I had a little brother about your age...
Oh... yes...

We both loved the sky, and we even promised,
'We're totally gonna be pilots someday!'
Stuff like that...
rows.notes: Both genders: the sibling is a brother (male) or sister (female), so no pronoun.

rows.en:
But... on a trip we'd been looking forward to
like crazy... there was a plane crash...
rows.notes: Both genders; no pronoun for the sibling.

rows.en:
And then... back when I was still a greenhorn
in the military, there was another greenhorn
who enlisted a little after me...
rows.notes: Both genders; gender of the recruit given in the next row.

rows.en:
She was a woman, but a real headstrong one.
Always trying to compete with me.
She was a cute one, though.

Along the way, we started spending a lot of time
together off duty, too. And, well,
we ended up in that kind of relationship...

It was just a totally routine flight...
Faulty maintenance on the plane, they said.
It was so stupid I couldn't even cry.
I had no idea something like that happened...

So yeah, I'm done with the sky.
If I can, I wanna live a laid-back life
with my feet on the ground.

Well, same goes for you.
Nobody knows what could happen, or when.
So enjoy the here and now, is what I'm saying.
Yes... I suppose so...
Sorry, I went and told you a gloomy story.
No, not at all...
rows.notes: Shared with Sheryl and Hilda scenes; neutral.

rows.en:
Well, life's full of ups and downs, that's all.
See ya.
(Gary-sensei went through all that...)

(I'm meeting Gary-sensei
at Central Park today.)
(Does the mood feel kind of different today...?)
You got any sisters?
I had a little sister about your age...

She was a woman, but a real headstrong one.
Always trying to compete with me.
She was a cute one, though.
rows.notes: Female only; same as male c05417 apart from a comma.

rows.en:
(We were meeting at Central Park again today,
right...)
Hey, you came...

Yes...
Sensei, what's wrong...?

Nah, it's nothing...
Will you hear me out again?
Sure, if I'm any help...
So yeah, that's something that happened...
rows.notes: Both genders. Closes an off-screen retelling.

rows.en: So that's what happened...

Y'know, it's nice talking to someone like this.
Feels like it settles my heart a little...
I'm glad to hear that.

Well, can't keep talking about stuff like that...
See you at school.
(Gary-sensei seems down...)
(We were meeting at Central Park again today.)
Sure, if I'm any help...
(Gary-sensei seems down...)
(Central Park again today... What's up...)
Hey, you came.
Sorry for dragging you out here again.

There's something I didn't get around to
saying last time...
Y'see, you look just like my little brother.

When you enrolled, I couldn't believe my eyes.
I was like, 'What the hell happened?!'

I figured out right away you were someone else,
but the resemblance was real...
So I kinda wanted to mess with you.

So getting to hang out with you and stuff
was kinda fun.
No, I should be the one saying that...

Honestly, thanks to you, I started thinking
maybe flying again wouldn't be so bad...
Now if only she'd come back...
rows.notes: Both genders. 'aitsu' = the woman from his story (c05417), so 'she'.

rows.en: Would that be me you're talking about?
Ugh, gah...

I bet you were going on again with
'my little brother' this, 'my old flame' that...
N-no, that's...

Anyway, I'd love to know when exactly
you and I ever had that kind of relationship.

(What?! Could that story have been about
Hilda-sensei...)

\p!
Don't take everything this guy says at face value.
I checked back in the military. He's got no little brother.
What?! Really?!

Ah, sorry, sorry. Once I got talking,
I kinda got carried away.
Whaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaat?!!!

Honestly...
Well, I got fooled by it too, back in the day.
R-really?

So that's what happens when you hang around
with this guy. Be careful.
See you.

No, really, sorry, sorry.
Think of it as a kind of recreation.
U-uh... okay...

But hey, it's true I had fun with you.
See ya!
Ah, Sensei!

(Well, I guess it's good that nobody
actually went through a tragedy.)
Y'see, you look just like my little sister.

uncertain: c05414/c05415: shared by both versions, where Gary's sibling is a brother (male) or a sister (female); written with 'we' and no pronoun.
c05457: 'aitsu' read as the woman from his story (Hilda turns up and asks if it is her), so 'she'.
c05460: Hilda's line read as addressed to Gary ('you were going on again'); it could be put to the player, but Gary answers it.
